entries.name: Google Play Movies & TV
entries.why: Store app for buying films. Your streaming apps already cover this.

entries.name: Google Play Games
entries.why: Games hub that runs in the background. Not needed for normal viewing.

entries.name: Google Feedback
entries.why: Sends feedback and crash reports to Google.

entries.name: YouTube Music
entries.why: Remove it if you don't listen to music on this TV.

entries.name: Google Partner Setup
entries.why: Setup helper for preinstalled partner apps. Not used day to day.

entries.name: One-time initializer
entries.why: Setup helper that already did its job.

entries.name: Netflix
entries.why: Remove only if you never use it. The Netflix button on the remote stops working.

entries.name: Prime Video
entries.why: Remove only if you never use it. The Prime button on the remote stops working.

entries.name: PatchWall (Mi home screen)
entries.why: Mi's home screen, where promotions and ads live. Removing it falls back to the standard Android TV home.
